18. Which of the following is the most reactive metal?
(A) Mg
(B) Ca
(C) Na
(D) K
19. In what ratio, the concentrated Hydrochloric acid and the concentrated Nitric acid solutions are present in freshly prepared aqua regia (royal water) solution -
(A) 3:2
(B) 2:3
(C) 3:1
(D) 1:3
20. Which one of the following is the functional group of —C(H)(=O)— ?
(A) Ketone
(B) Carboxylic acid
(C) Alcohol
(D) Aldehyde
21. Propane, with the molecular formula C₃H₈ has -
(A) 7 covalent bonds
(B) 8 covalent bonds
(C) 9 covalent bonds
(D) 10 covalent bonds

notes: Q20's chemical structure is a drawn aldehyde group (—CHO, carbon double-bonded to O, single-bonded to H) shown as a small diagram, not plain text — transcribed as a text description consistent with Stage B scope (capture what's seen, no image redrawing).
